system.description:
FOCUS INVESTED INVOCATION

Level 10; Price 6,000 gp; Usage any weapon; Activate Engage (1 AP)

This rune rewards a moment of perfect concentration before an attack.

Add your Wisdom ability score to your next attack roll with the weapon, which must be made before the beginning of your next turn. The rune then becomes expended and can be restored with Refocus.

On the sheet: Press Mindful on the weapon (Engage, 1 AP): your Wisdom is offered on your next attack roll — tick it on the attack you make with this weapon. Unused, it ends at the start of your next turn. The rune is then expended; Refocus restores it.
